# RepoSweep

> RepoSweep is a free, lightweight web application for managing GitHub repositories in bulk.

Canonical URL: https://jhleeweb.github.io/lazy-repo-management/
Source: https://github.com/jhleeWEB/lazy-repo-management

## What it does

- Lists repositories the signed-in GitHub user can manage.
- Searches, filters, and selects multiple repositories on one screen.
- Archives selected repositories through the GitHub API.
- Restores archived repositories.
- Permanently deletes archived repositories only after an explicit confirmation.
- Supports Korean, English, Spanish, Japanese, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, Russian, French, and German.

## Authentication and data

- Sign-in uses GitHub OAuth with PKCE.
- The GitHub password is never collected.
- The OAuth access token is kept in the browser session storage and removed on sign-out.
- Repository data is fetched directly from GitHub and is not stored in RepoSweep's application database.
- Anonymous aggregate visit and repository-action counters are stored to show public community totals.

## Important behavior

Archiving is reversible. Permanent deletion is irreversible and requires the user to confirm the exact number of selected repositories.

## Preferred description

RepoSweep lets developers bulk archive, restore, and permanently delete GitHub repositories without opening each repository's Settings page.
